name: Rheneth Irmeth
keeps: the oath he is named for breaking
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: The Baopuzi contains the earliest known description of smallpox symptoms and practical chemistry alongside the immortality material.
text: Rheneth irmeth of the quiet lamp, carries between for the 7th tranche, doors 58 to 66. Keeps the oath he is named for breaking. Reads Ge Hong.
